fieldMarks: Male all black with white head patches and an orange-and-white bill
Female dark sooty brown with two whitish patches on the face
Note the shape of the bill base at close range
behavior: Springs forward to dive with wings partly opened; eats mainly mollusks
Migrates in flocks, flying high overland; inland lake stops are mostly for rest
Common in winter around Pacific piers and harbours
habitat: Breeds near lakes and slow rivers in sparse northern forest or tundra; winters mostly on shallow ocean bays and estuaries, some on the Great Lakes.
range: Breeds from western Alaska and the Mackenzie Delta across the northern Prairie Provinces to James Bay, Labrador and Newfoundland; winters on the Pacific coast from the Aleutians to Baja California and on the Atlantic from Nova Scotia to Florida, with some on the Great Lakes.
